name: logo-design
description: Use this skill when the user asks a design agent to design, redesign, refine, critique, or explore a logo, wordmark, monogram, brand mark, lockup, favicon mark, or logo variants. It teaches logo design judgment, mark architecture, typographic register, small-size discipline, and presentation standards, then directs the agent to create and verify the actual logo exploration as a Hivy Canvas artifact with the canvas skill.
human_description: Teach agents tasteful logo direction and Canvas artifact logo exploration.
